text:
Olivia (AE): Hey finance — need an exception approved. Customer 'Meridian Analytics' is asking for Net30 terms + a one-year promotional discount. Details below, requesting quick turnaround (they want to sign this week).

Jordan (RevOps): paste the deal terms pls. who is the billing entity, expected ARR, and is there a PO?

Olivia (AE): Quick paste: 
- Customer: Meridian Analytics (US corporate)
- Billing contact: ap@meridian-analytics.com
- Suggested pricing (list): $120,000 committed for 12 months (paid monthly in arrears)
- Ask: 25% off list for first 12 months, Net30 payment terms (standard is Net15 for us), ability to invoice monthly
- Reason: strategic pilot with clear expansion path (expected +3x in year 2), they have procurement constraints and require Net30 to get internal approval.
- Start: Apr 1
- AE owner: Olivia

Priya (Finance Manager): Need to confirm credit posture. New customer? Any credit check done? Net30 increases DSO risk — 25% discount is material. Also need billing entity and if the contract requires any revenue deferral treatment. Do we have precedent for Net30 + >20% discount without upfront?

Olivia (AE): They're a new customer — no credit on file. Procurement said they can do a PO but it won't be issued until after signature. We can request a 1-month deposit but it'll slow closing. Precedent: we did Net30 + 20% for OneCart last quarter but they provided PO upfront.

Omar (Head of RevOps): Tagging deal-desk: what’s the minimum approval path? I can approve pricing exceptions up to 20% w/ finance signoff. >20% needs VP sales + finance. Net30 can be approved for strategic accounts with a credit hold clause.

Lucy (Legal): We need to ensure contract has: (1) explicit payment schedule, (2) 30-day late fee/interest, (3) right to suspend access for non-payment, and (4) standard data protections. If they insist on custom invoicing cadence, route to legal to review.

Jordan (RevOps): To move fast: can the AE get a 1x deposit (one month) and drop discount to 20%? That would put this inside Omar's approval band. If customer balks, escalate to VP.Sales for sign-off.

Olivia (AE): Pitched 1x deposit + 20% and they pushed back — procurement said budget only allows 25% off. They said they can wire a deposit if required but prefer not to. Asking if Finance will approve 25% for first year if we add a credit hold clause and require a PO within 30 days.

Priya (Finance Manager): Our proposal: Approve 25% for 6 months, then revert to 10% unless they hit usage milestones. Net30 allowed if we get either: (A) signed PO within 30 days + billing email, OR (B) a 1-month deposit before provisioning. Also require billing team to set credit hold trigger at 45 days overdue. That limits exposure.

Omar (Head of RevOps): I can sign off on 25% for first 6 months under Priya’s conditions. For the 12-month ask at 25% we need VP Sales sign-off. I suggest we offer 25% for 6 months then 10% thereafter, or 20% for full year with no deposit. Which does the customer prefer?

Olivia (AE): Customer responded: they're willing to accept 25% for 6 months followed by 10% if we can get Net30 and PO within 30 days. They can provide a PO but it will only be effective after signature. They've agreed to a 30-day payment term and to start with a pilot budget of $10k/month.

billing-bot: Exception logged: EXC-2026-089 — Net30 + promotional discount request recorded. Requires Finance (Priya) and RevOps (Omar) approval. Please attach PO or deposit to close.

Lucy (Legal): Please attach the proposed SOW and I'll confirm the suspension and late fee language.

Priya (Finance Manager): OK — conditional approval granted: 25% for first 6 months, Net30, requirement of PO within 30 days OR 1-month deposit. Billing to set credit hold at >45 days past due. Document the exception in the deal desk tracker and flag for AR review.

Omar (Head of RevOps): Approved on my end under the same conditions. AE, get the PO or deposit and attach in the deal tracker.

Olivia (AE): Got it. I'll push the PO and accept the 6mo/10mo cadence. Customer confirmed they'll submit PO within 14 days. Thanks everyone. 

Jordan (RevOps): I'll update the deal desk tracker and mark EXC-2026-089 as approved contingent on PO.

Olivia (AE): Final note — can billing please confirm the invoice schedule will be monthly in arrears and include the discount line item?

billing-bot: Noted — invoice schedule set to monthly-in-arrears, discount line item to be added. Will keep account on credit watch until PO is attached.

Priya (Finance Manager): Closing note: once PO is attached, finance will release provisioning. If PO not received in 30 days, we'll require a deposit before provisioning. Thanks.
